question: How do GraphRAG, LightRAG and HippoRAG compare in how they use a knowledge graph for retrieval?

frames.data: data: {"type":"block","block":{"type":"CitedSummary","id":"turn-f22937357663","meta":{"status":"ready","error":null},"data":{"segments":[{"text":"GraphRAG (the Microsoft paper) uses an LLM to build a knowledge graph of entities and relationships, partitions it into a hierarchy of communities, and generates community-level summaries. Queries are answered by map-reduce over those summaries, which supports global sensemaking over a whole corpus.","citationIds":["c1"]},{"text":"LightRAG combines graph structures with vector representations and uses dual-level retrieval, covering low-level and high-level knowledge discovery. Its retrieval is vector-based but targets entities and relationships rather than chunks. LightRAG's authors say this reduces retrieval overhead compared with the community-based traversal in GraphRAG.","citationIds":["c2","c3"]},{"text":"HippoRAG combines LLMs, knowledge graphs and the Personalized PageRank algorithm, modeled on the roles of the neocortex and hippocampus in human memory. It targets multi-hop question answering, and its single-step retrieval matches or beats iterative retrieval such as IRCoT at lower cost.","citationIds":["c4"]},{"text":"Across the documents, all three use LLM-supported knowledge graphs, but they differ in how they retrieve. GraphRAG relies on community summaries, LightRAG on vector search over entities and relationships, and HippoRAG on Personalized PageRank. The passages give no more detail on HippoRAG's graph construction or on how it retrieves.","citationIds":["c1","c3","c4"]}],"citations":[{"id":"c1","chunkId":"730f1a9f38d16689_c_4e7880c9886117d5","docId":"730f1a9f38d16689","docTitle":"2404.16130_From_Local_to_Global_A_Graph_RAG_Approach_to_Query_Focused_Summarizati","page":2,"quote":"GraphRAG first uses an LLM to construct a knowledge graph, where nodes correspond to key entities in the corpus and edges represent relationships between those entities."},{"id":"c2","chunkId":"bd72eebf611df136_c_28e35e268088acc2","docId":"bd72eebf611df136","docTitle":"2410.05779_LightRAG_Simple_and_Fast_Retrieval_Augmented_Generation","page":1,"quote":"dual-level retrieval sys- tem that enhances comprehensive information retrieval from both low-level and high-level knowledge discovery"},{"id":"c3","chunkId":"bd72eebf611df136_c_ce8e12d9a8fa510d","docId":"bd72eebf611df136","docTitle":"2410.05779_LightRAG_Simple_and_Fast_Retrieval_Augmented_Generation","page":5,"quote":"instead of retrieving chunks as in conventional RAG, we concentrate on retrieving entities and relationships.
